integrity: All definitions and finite-size comparisons are proved with exact rational stationary ratios; the large-population statement is analytical; 46,765 independent finite rational assertions were checked in the included standalone source. Originality assessment is bounded by the inspected primary sources.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete-graph, homogeneous Markovian SIS model only. The theorem distinguishes local stationary modes, not peak mass, a thermodynamic discontinuity, epidemiological prediction, or empirical parameter inference.
title: Sharp stationary double-mode onset in a finite SIS epidemic with an external reservoir
